label: Grateful
acknowledgment: Gratitude is not simply something you feel. It is a way of seeing: noticing the blessings you might otherwise overlook, and remembering the One behind them.

verses.translation_en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
verses.context: The verse leaves the nature of that increase open, reminding us that Allah’s generosity can reach us in ways beyond what we expect.

verses.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
verses.translation_en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
verses.context: Remembrance turns the heart toward Allah, while gratitude turns it toward His blessings. Here, the two are woven together.

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا
verses.translation_en: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them.
verses.context: The verse reminds us that gratitude begins with noticing, even when what we have could never be fully counted.

verses.translation_en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.context: Repeated thirty-one times in Surah Ar-Rahman, after every description of mercy.

verses.translation_en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor.
verses.context: Sulaiman asks Allah to enable him to be grateful. Gratitude itself is sought as a gift.

verses.translation_en: And few of My servants are grateful.
verses.context: The verse names gratitude as a rare quality, and so it is precious.

verses.translation_en: And whoever is grateful is grateful for his own benefit.
verses.context: The blessing of gratitude belongs to the one who is grateful.

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِلَّهِ
verses.translation_en: O you who have believed, eat from the good things which We have provided for you and be grateful to Allah.
verses.context: Gratitude is linked to the simplest gifts, even food.

verses.arabic: فَكُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاشْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ
verses.translation_en: So eat of the lawful and good food which Allah has provided for you, and be grateful for the favor of Allah.
verses.context: Gratitude is commanded for what has been given.

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.translation_en: We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
verses.context: The righteous give without expecting gratitude in return.

names_of_allah.explanation: He does not overlook even the smallest good. Sincere gratitude is never lost with Him.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the chests.
And Allah is Appreciative and Forbearing.

names_of_allah.explanation: He is the One who provides for every living thing, sustaining each according to His wisdom.

evidence_verses.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ
evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, it is Allah who is the Provider, the Possessor of strength, the Firm.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا
evidence_verses.translation_en: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision.

names_of_allah.explanation: His giving does not decrease Him. His generosity is not measured by what we deserve.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous.

evidence_verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ
evidence_verses.translation_en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous?

names_of_allah.explanation: Some blessings arrive before we know to ask for them. Every gift is from the One who bestows without measure.
He is praised for who He is, not only for what He gives. Praise belongs to Him regardless of circumstance.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

personal_question: What blessing have you grown so used to that you no longer notice it?
